notes: Proof House on Ethereum mainnet, first drop ARTIFACTS (THE SOURCE by auction first, then 255 editions; supply 256, fixed). No fungible token or pool. IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) is the existing ERC-20 buyers may pay with for plain SVG collections. 7 contracts, not the brief's 8: audit finding 180a7e1d59e1 (accepted, fixed in this tree) measured the 8 at about 20.9M gas in the one launch transaction, over the 2^24 (16,777,216) per-transaction cap Ethereum mainnet enforces since Fusaka (EIP-7825), so no gas price could include it. ArtifactsPiece (the 24 KB locked template every piece is a runtime copy of; no owner) left the launch; the 7 measure about 15.2M. ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource therefore take ($owner, ArtHouse) and receive the piece once through the owner-only setPieceImplementation; neither sale can open before it is set, and it can never change. The curator deploys ArtifactsPiece right after, from launch.piece.json, with the launched KeyProof, and compares its runtime with a build of this commit before connecting it. Every other contract, order and constructor argument is as the brief lists. Owners: ArtStorage, ArtHouse, ArtifactsFactory, ArtifactsSource are $owner, two-step, no renounce, no upgrade. BrokerPass: at most 100 free passes, one per wallet, claimed with an ARTIFACTS piece or an identity.md seat (0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d); holders are Proof House brokers; claims open at a time the factory's owner sets once (setClaimsOpenAt). SubmissionReviews: advisory reviews of artist submissions, one voice per identity.md seat and per claimed ARTIFACTS piece, frozen once the curator decides; no owner. KeyProof: no owner. ImdBuybackBurner is not in this launch either: the curator deploys it from launch.burner.json and connects it with ArtHouse.setBuybackBurner. Nothing is called during the launch. Afterwards the owner deploys ArtifactsPiece and calls setPieceImplementation on ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource, calls ArtStorage.setHouse, ArtHouse.setBrokerPass, approves the artist, registers ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource as sale modules and module collections, sets THE SOURCE's split to 15/0/85, configures VRF, calls ArtHouse.setBuybackBurner, and at launch BrokerPass.setClaimsOpenAt.
